plain_description.what: The full new judge was run end to end on about 2,000 matches. It combines a production template, a reasoning model's reference answer, a subject-level rubric, judging in both orders, and confidence scores. Six pass/fail checks were set in advance.
plain_description.why: It tests whether the assembled cheap judge is good enough to be adopted as the production judge.
plain_description.information: Passing would let the design be adopted. Any failed check marks a remaining weakness. Result: done. 5 of 6 checks pass: accuracy 0.843, a large gain over the old judge (+7 points), and fewer ties, flips and length bias. The ranking check failed: two order errors among the top 4 models, against 1 allowed. The design was still registered as the next version (STACK-v2). Later ruled history rather than evidence, because it ran on the older question pool.
